trap-nonspeakable.notes: RIGOR (reported, not fixed - MAJOR, the antipode as defined is not an endomorphism of H_n(R,q)). (1) S(sigma_i) = sigma_i^{-1} IS NOT q-LINEAR. If sigma satisfies the SS7a relation (sigma - q)(sigma + q^{-1}) = 0 then sigma^{-1} = sigma - h satisfies (x - q^{-1})(x + q) = 0 - the relation with q replaced by q^{-1}. Checked directly: sigma^{-2} = -h.sigma + 1 + h^2, whereas h.sigma^{-1} + 1 = h.sigma - h^2 + 1, and these differ unless h = 0. So sigma_i |-> sigma_i^{-1} is an isomorphism H_n(q) -> H_n(q^{-1}), i.e. it is the Kazhdan-Lusztig BAR INVOLUTION, semilinear over q |-> q^{-1} on R - not a canonical antipode of H_n(R,q) with q held fixed. Proposed: state the bar-semilinearity explicitly. (2) TWO DIFFERENT MAPS ARE BOTH CALLED S IN THIS CHAPTER. conj:flavor-split-habiro-derivation defines the Hopf antipode as S(T_w) = T_{w^{-1}}, which FIXES every generator (s_i^{-1} = s_i in S_n, so T_{s_i^{-1}} = T_{s_i}); this block's S INVERTS every generator. They are different maps and the chapter must not share a symbol between them. (3) ABSOLUTE-MASS CONTEXT: item 2 and the closing phrase the mass correction refer to the neutron-tower closure, whose sibling remark rem:frobenius-antipode-neutron-tower-closure claims a sub-ppm absolute neutron mass - the excised class (owner ruling 2026-08-11).
